root_cause: An exact-identity torch.where selected the base-probability branch whenever the initialized residual equaled zero. That branch also blocked every residual gradient, so optimization only weight-decayed unused hidden weights and could never leave the identity state.
correction: Remove the redundant torch.where. IEEE addition by an exact zero plus clamp already preserves all in-range base probabilities bitwise, while retaining the residual gradient.
corrected_run_rule: Reuse the sealed source shards, training recipe, and precommitted LOSO gates; write a new v2 result without overwriting the superseded execution.
